Validate coords: [lon, lat] array, structure + range
Calculate distance (m) or area (sq m), server-side
INSERT measurement (type, name, coords, value, unit)
Validate cookie + CSRF + check role (Admin or owning PM)
- Missing type, name, or coordinates: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
- User not assigned to survey's project: 403 Forbidden
- SE, Viewer, or non-owning PM attempts delete: 403
- Delete on non-existent measurement_id: 404 Not Found
- Unsafe request without valid CSRF token: 403 CSRF_FAILURE
- Create / Read: active assigned Administrator, Project
Manager, Survey Engineer, and Viewer may all create and
- Delete: Administrator or the owning Project Manager only

- The client submits raw coordinates only; Maps Module

- Audit Module is called synchronously on create and
